name: EasySecure Bulk Product Importer for WooCommerce
author: imminentsoftwares

sections.description:
WooCommerce Product Importer – Bulk Upload via CSV & Excel is the ultimate solution for quickly adding and managing products in your WooCommerce store. Save hours of manual work by importing Simple and Variable products directly from CSV or Excel files. With smart field mapping and automatic variation creation, you can bulk upload products with multiple attributes like Size, Color, and Material — all in just a few clicks. The only requirement is that the title and slug should match each other.

Features include:
– Excel/CSV product import
– Supports simple and variable products
– Map Excel columns to product fields
– Import multiple attributes like size, color
– Set stock, categories, tags, and custom meta
– Error handling and validation for clean imports
– Compatible with WooCommerce-based stores.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/woocommerce-product-importer-bulk-upload’ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Product Import > Import Products from the admin menu.
  4. Upload your Excel or CSV file and follow the mapping steps.
sections.faq:
Which file types are supported?

‘.xlsx’ and ‘.csv’ files are supported.

Can I import variable products?

Yes. You can specify attributes like size and color, and the plugin will generate variations automatically.

Does this plugin support custom meta fields?

Yes. You can map any custom meta fields during import.
